<subject>Lumière Santé Email Undeliverable: Cannot locate you</subject>
<body>
We received your email addressed to p953@trialttech.com. Unfortunately, we cannot find your username or email address listed as a current member or subscriber of Lumière Santé. 

Membership at Lumière Santé is free and allows you to search the profiles of millions of quality medical professionals, post your own profile, view your best personal matches, receive new matches by email, and more. But to make anonymous contact with profiles that catch your eye, you must join as a paid subscriber. For details, click here: https://www.lumieresante.fr/medpro/

If you are a current subscriber and believe you've received this email in error, please contact our Clinical Operations at: suzanne.bodin@lumieresante.fr

For your convenience, we've included the text of your personal message below:

To: p953@trialttech.com
Subject: RE: Lumière Santé - You've Got Mail: Hi Plucci!
Hello,

Thanks for sending me an email.  I appreciate the interest and found
your profile to be interesting as well.  But, I feel I'm at a
disadvantage due to the fact that your profile doesn't contain a
picture.  Are you sending a picture over later, or making me guess as to
what you look like?  Drop me a line and we can hash this out.

Antoine
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: p953@trialttech.com
Sent: Saturday, 22 November 2025 14:39
To: lucas.lopes@lumieresante.fr
Subject: Lumière Santé - You've Got Mail: Hi Plucci!


Hi - I'll be honest - I thought you were cute.  Hopefully you are as
interesting as you are attractive :)  

Take a look at my profile and send me an e-mail if you'd like.  Hope to
hear from you!

Click the following link to view the sender's profile:
https://www.lumieresante.fr/medpro/
rackingid=0

The following is my profile text:

I never thought I'd be using a "medical networking service". But I'm open to trying
new things - so let's give it a try. I'm an outgoing, positive, fun
person. I LOVE to travel and experience new medical conferences and workshops. I'm
always learning something new - right now it's the latest medical research. I'm also
really happy being alone with myself to read, write, or just putz
around. I love working with patients, and they love me - probably because I'm pretty much
a people person at heart still. I'm very close to my colleagues and have probably too
many good contacts - I spend a lot of time keeping up with them all. 

*********************************************************

ADDITIONAL TIPS from Lumière Santé:

Our anonymous re-mailer will strip away your real email address, so 
that it will NOT appear in the 'From:' line.

You may also contact this person from their Lumière Santé profile by 
clicking 'Contact this person' and composing your message directly from
the 
site.

However:

* Check to ensure that your email address is not in the BODY of your 
message as we are unable to remove these.

* Check to ensure that you REMOVE ANY AUTOMATIC SIGNATURE at the end of 

your email. And note that you cannot use 'Cc:' or 'Bcc:' if you want 
your email to remain anonymous.

Lumière Santé does not monitor private email between members, nor are we 
liable for the content of these messages. All members are bound by our 
Code de Conduite.


**********************************************************************
